description:
sedoriMAX is a purchasing and sales management service (mobile app + web dashboard) for individuals and small businesses who resell products on online marketplaces and flea-market apps. After you connect your sedoriMAX account, this plugin answers questions and helps with inventory and listing tasks using your own sedoriMAX data.

What you can do
• View inventory, listing, and sold-item data (for example, “What were my sales and profit this month?” or “What was the purchase price of the item I just added?”)
• Get sourcing insights from marketplace catalog search, current prices, fee-aware profit estimates, and up to two years of price history and sales-velocity data
• Review sourcing statistics by store, including visit counts, success rates, and estimated profit
• Write listing descriptions from your product photos, tailored to the condition grade, sales channel, and fulfillment method, and save them to the inventory item so they appear in the app’s listing form
• Keep reusable listing-writing instructions (standard phrases and style) in your sedoriMAX settings
• Register completed purchases from flea-market or auction sites as new, unlisted inventory items (a purchase that is already registered is skipped)

Write access is limited to registering purchases as new inventory items, saving listing descriptions, saving your listing-writing instructions, and setting or clearing a “needs your attention” note. The plugin does not publish listings, change prices, or delete records. Buyer personal data and payment information are not included.

A sedoriMAX member account is required. Live catalog and price lookups require marketplace seller integration to be configured in sedoriMAX.
